stories.storyName: Journey To Become A Househusband in A Dungeon Reverse World
stories.description:
Since he was 17, John has increasingly developed the desire to become a stay-at-home househusband and closely take care of his future children. Making sure they grow up well and not become a self-proclaimed mess like he is.

However, even though society has progressed enough that househusbands aren't unheard of, many still look down on them. Viewing them as lazy, leeching off women, etc. And being a self-assessed 6/10 himself, John reluctantly pushed away this dream, as time went by.

Then a miracle(?) happened. While cooking dinner, a status window like those from fiction appeared before him.

[Whatever your dream may be, you can realize it here! Transfer to another world? Yes / No ]

It didn't take long for him to realize it isn't a hallucination. Though, he was sad that he wouldn't be to see his loved ones again, he still pressed [ Yes ].

Just like his wildest fantasies, he was transferred to a "reverse world" where the sexual values of women and men were reversed. And with a 1:5 men to women ratio! Working women were the norm and openly expressive of their desires. While men were expected to stay at home and raise children. This world also has interdimensional portals or "dungeons", superhumans called "Hunters" tackled them; slaughtering monsters, obtaining various treasures and leveling up. And god-like entities called "Constellations" who empower and watch over their selected champions.

In this world, John can freely chase his dream of being a househusband.

But is there really no price..?

Updates will come in droves every now and then.
